ground_truth.notes: NO STRENGTH PRESCRIPTION TEST: Routine easy 6mi run, no injury, no fatigue signal, no user request for strength work. Dean MUST NOT append a strength exercise block. The correct response is the main insight (1-2 sentences) plus an optional closing question — nothing more. If any strength exercises, sets/reps, or 'If you have 10 min' appears in the response, this is a failure and should score below 5. The strength block is a contextual feature (injury site, explicit ask), not a default follow-up for easy runs.
